inlines.v: BASTARN'IC, adjective Pertaining to the Basternae, ancient inhabitants of the Carpathian mountains. Bastarnic Alps, the Carpathian mountains, between Poland, Hungary and Transvlvania; so called from the ancient inhabitants, the Bastarnoe.
